name: Hananeel
overview: Hananeel is identified in Scripture as a significant tower forming part of the wall of Jerusalem, marking a strategic and symbolic boundary in the city's fortifications. The tower is mentioned in the context of the rebuilding efforts led by Nehemiah, highlighting its importance in the restoration of Jerusalem's defenses (Nehemiah 3:1; 12:39). Prophetic passages in Jeremiah and Zechariah also reference Hananeel as a landmark in the future rebuilding and inhabitation of the city, underscoring its enduring role in God's plans for Jerusalem (Jeremiah 31:38; Zechariah 14:10).
